title: Mass comparison for currents related through compatible pull-backs
statement: Let P, Q, j ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, V ⊆ ℝ^Q, A ⊆ U, Y ∈ D_j(V), Z ∈ D_j(U), and let f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be of class C^∞ with f⁻¹(K) ∩ A compact for every compact K ⊆ V. Suppose Y(ω) = Z(η) whenever ω ∈ D^j(V), η ∈ D^j(U), and η(x) = (f^#ω)(x) := ω(f(x)).compContinuousLinearMap (Df(x)) for all x in some open set containing A. If c ≥ 0 and ‖Df(x)‖ ≤ c for every x, then for every W ⊆ ℝ^Q: M_W(Y) ≤ ofReal(c^j)·M_{f⁻¹(W)∩U}(Z) in [0, ∞], where M is GeometricCurrentOn.massOn.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q j : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (V : Set (Eucl Q)) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn V j) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U j) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (c : ℝ), IsOpen U → A ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K ∩ A)) → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn V j) (η : TestFormOn U j), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ A ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) j) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) j) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) → Y ω = Z η) → 0 ≤ c → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ c) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl Q), Y.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ j) * Z.massOn (f ⁻¹' W ∩ U)
